arabic_text: أيُّهَا الْخَلْقُ الْمُطِيعُ الدَّائِبُ السَّرِيعُ الْمُتَرَدِّدُ فِي مَنَازِلِ التَّقْدِيْرِ، الْمُتَصَرِّفُ فِي فَلَكِ التَّدْبِيرِ،
transliteration: ʾayyuhā al-khalqu al-muṭīʿu al-dāʾibu al-sarīʿu al-mutaraddidu fi manazili al-taqdeer al-mutaṣarrif fī falak al-tadbīr
english_text: O obedient creature, speedy and untiring, frequenter of the mansions of determination, moving about in the sphere of governance!

arabic_text: آمَنْتُ بِمَنْ نَوَّرَ بِكَ الظُّلَمَ، وَأَوْضَحَ بِـكَ الْبُهَمَ، وَجَعَلَكَ آيَةً مِنْ آياتِ مُلْكِهِ، وَعَلاَمَةً مِنْ عَلاَمَاتِ سُلْطَانِهِ،
transliteration: āmantu bi-man nawwara bika aẓ-ẓulama wa 'awḍaḥa bika al-buhamah wa jaʿalaka ʾayatan min ʾayati mulkihi waʿalāmātan min ʿalāmāti sulṭānih
english_text: I have faith in Him who lights up darknesses through thee, illuminates jet-black shadows by thee, appointed thee one of the signs of His kingdom and one of the marks of His authority,

arabic_text: وَامْتَهَنَكَ بِالزِّيادَةِ وَالنُّقْصَانِ، وَالطُّلُوعِ وَالأُفُولِ، وَالإِنارَةِ وَالْكُسُوفِ،
transliteration: wa-amtahanaka bil-ziyadati wal-nuqsaan wal-ṭṭulūʿi wal-ufuli, wal-i’nārat wal-kusūfi
english_text: and humbled thee through increase and decrease, rising and setting, illumination and eclipse.

arabic_text: فِي كُلِّ ذلِكَ أَنْتَ لَهُ مُطِيعٌ وَإلى إرَادَتِهِ سَرِيعٌ،
transliteration: fī kulli dhālika anta lahū muṭīʿun wa-ilā irādatihi sariʿun
english_text: In all of this thou art obedient to Him, prompt toward His will.

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَهُ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا دَبَّرَ فِيْ أَمْرِكَ،
transliteration: subḥānahu mā aʿjab ma dabbara fī amrika
english_text: Glory be to Him! How wonderful is what He has arranged in thy situation!
How subtle what He has made for thy task!

arabic_text: جَعَلَكَ مِفْتَاحَ شَهْر حَادِث لأَِمْر حادِث،
transliteration: jaʿalaka miftāḥa shahr ḥādith li-amr ḥādith
english_text: He has made thee the key to a new month for a new situation.

arabic_text: فَأَسْأَلُ اللهَ رَبِّي وَرَبَّكَ وَخَالِقِي وَخَالِقَكَ وَمُقَدِّرِي وَمُقَدِّرَكَ وَمُصَوِّرِي وَمُصَوِّرَكَ أَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ،
transliteration: fa-as'alullaha rabbī wa rabbaka wa khāliqī wa khāliqak wa muqaddirī wa muqaddirak wa musawwiri wa musawwiraka 'an yuṣallī 'alā muḥammad wa ālihī
english_text: So I ask God, my Lord and thy Lord, my Creator and thy Creator, my Determiner and thy Determiner, my Form-giver and thy Form-giver, that He bless Muhammad and his Household

arabic_text: وَأَنْ يَجْعَلَكَ هِلاَلَ بَرَكَة لاَ تَمْحَقُهَا الأيَّامُ، وَطَهَارَة لاَ تُدَنِّسُهَا الآثامُ،
transliteration: wa-an yajʿalaka hilālan barakah lā tamḥaquhā al-ayyām waṭahāratun lā tudannisuhā al-āthām
english_text: and appoint thee a crescent of blessings not effaced by days and of purity not defiled by sins;

arabic_text: هِلاَلَ أَمْن مِنَ الآفاتِ، وَسَلاَمَة مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ،
transliteration: hilāla amn min al-ʾafāt wasalāmata mina as-sayyiātِ
english_text: a crescent of security from blights and of safety from evil deeds;

arabic_text: هِلاَلَ سَعْد لاَ نَحْسَ فِيْهِ، وَيُمْن لاَ نَكَدَ مَعَهُ، وَيُسْر لاَ يُمَازِجُهُ عُسْرٌ، وَخَيْر لاَ يَشُوبُهُ شَرٌّ،
transliteration: hilāla saʿd lā naḥsa fīhi wayumnu laa nakada maʿahu wayusr la yumāziġuhu ʿusr wa khayr la yashubuhu shar
english_text: a crescent of auspiciousness containing no misfortune, of prosperity accompanied by no adversity, of ease not mixed with difficulty, of good unstained by evil;

arabic_text: هِلاَلَ أَمْن وَإيمَان وَنِعْمَة وَإحْسَان وَسَلاَمَة وَإسْلاَم.
transliteration: hilāla amn wa ʾīmān wa niʿma wa iḥsān wa salāma wa ʾislām
english_text: a crescent of security and faith, favour and good-doing, safety and submission!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَرْضَى مَنْ طَلَعَ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَزْكَى مَنْ نَظَرَ إليْهِ، وَأَسْعَدَ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيهِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-jaʿlna min arḍā man ṭalʿa ʿalayhi waʾazkā man naẓara ʾilayhi wa-asʿada man taʿabbada laka fiih
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, place us among the most satisfied of those over whom the crescent has risen, the purest of those who have looked upon it, the most fortunate of those who have worshipped Thee under it;

arabic_text: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِيهِ لِلتَّوْبَةِ، وَاعْصِمْنَـا فِيْهِ مِنَ الْحَـوْبَةِ، وَاحْفَظْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ مُبَاشَرَةِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، وَأَوْزِعْنَا فِيهِ شُكْرَ نِعْمَتِكَ،
transliteration: wa waffiqnā fīhi liltawbah waʿṣimnā fīhi min al-ḥawbah wa aḥfaẓnā fīhi min mubāsharati maʿṣiyatika wa auziʿna fihi shukra niʿmatik
english_text: give us the success during [the new month] to repent, preserve us within it from misdeeds, guard us therein from pursuing disobedience to Thee, allot to us within it thanksgiving for Thy favour,

arabic_text: وَأَلْبِسْنَا فِيهِ جُنَنَ الْعَافِيَةِ، وَأَتْمِمْ عَلَيْنَا بِاسْتِكْمَالِ طَاعَتِكَ فِيهِ الْمِنَّةَ،
transliteration: wa'albisnā fīhi junnan al-ʿāfiyah wa atmim ʿalayna bi-istikmali ṭāʿatika fīhi al-minna
english_text: clothe us during it in the shields of well-being, and complete for us Thy kindness by perfecting therein obedience to Thee!

arabic_text: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ.
transliteration: waṣalla allāhu ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi aṭ-ṭayyibīna aṭ-ṭāhirīna
english_text: And bless Muhammad and his Household, the good, the pure.
